summary: Tested PART 1 of the FSE 2.0 (simulated) + Passaporto reorganisation end-to-end on demo patient Pietro Fontana (backed up with mongoexport and restored afterwards). Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (passport payload portal/fse/consents, kind consents fse/passaporto + validation, sign -> non_inviato with reason, re-evaluation on PATCH -> in_coda -> inviato -> accettato, invalid CF -> errore, retry, 409 for draft retry/publish, obscure/unobscure, publish obscured -> 409, /fse/pending, revoke). Frontend: tab order/names correct, Crescita shows the chart, header shows 3 consent badges, Visite e referti shows 3 badges per report, draft shows 'Verifica e firma prima il referto' with Pubblica disabled, publish/obscure/unobscure/Invia al FSE work and update badges, deadline text shown, consents register/history/revoke work, Passaporto e FSE tab (status, preview, visible/hidden lists, shares, consent state, missing data + 'Completa i dati' -> PatientDialog with patient-guardian-cf-input, sends list) works, Home oggi-stat-fse tile shows count + 'scadenza più vicina' and goes to /app/pazienti?vista=visite. Main defect: the signer/guardian mismatch warning is a false positive for every demo patient, because guardian is stored as 'Mamma: Ilaria Fontana'.

critical.issue: False positive. patient.guardian holds a relation prefix ('Mamma: Ilaria Fontana', 'Papà: Luca Lombardi' on all demo patients), and _norm_name(signer_name) is compared to the whole string. A consent signed by the real mother 'Ilaria Fontana' therefore gets signer_mismatch=true, and so does the existing privacy consent. Fix: before comparing, strip the 'Mamma:/Papà:/Tutore:...' prefix (text before ':') from the guardian, or keep the guardian's name in a separate field.

Revoking the FSE consent leaves already queued reports in_coda, and they still advance to inviato/accettato. Reproduced: the legacy report was in_coda, the FSE consent was revoked, the next passport read gave 'accettato' with fse.consent=false. Fix: on FSE consent revoke, move in_coda reports back to non_inviato with a reason, or check the consent in advance() before sending.

minor.issue: Removing the obscuring from a report that was already inviato/accettato calls on_signed again, which puts it back in_coda and sends it a second time. The previous FSE outcome is lost. It also does not restore portal_published (obscuring cleared it).

The state only advances when someone reads GET /patients/{pid}/passport. /fse/pending (Home tile) counts in_coda reports until the patient record is opened. This is acceptable for a mock but worth noting.
signed_at is set to created_at, so the deadline is already past ('scaduta da 110 g'). Reports signed before the connector existed also have fse=null and are never counted in /fse/pending.

ui_bugs.issue: The signer field is prefilled with patient.guardian including the prefix ('Mamma: Ilaria Fontana'). Typing the real name 'Ilaria Fontana' shows consent-kind-mismatch. The frontend comparison (lowercase only) also differs from the backend _norm_name (accent/whitespace folding).

integration_issues.flow: Passaporto e FSE -> Completa i dati -> Salva
integration_issues.issue: After the PatientDialog is saved, the Scheda paziente goes back to the Panoramica tab instead of staying on 'Passaporto e FSE', so the user doesn't see the missing-data box turn complete.
It goes to /app/pazienti?vista=visite, but that list has no FSE status or filter, so the user can't see which reports are pending. Probably part 2 (filters/icons).

issues: The 'Consenso FSE assente' and 'Consenso Passaporto assente' badges use bg-[var(--raised)], which is the same colour as the header background. They look like plain text, not badges like 'Consenso privacy valido'.
The button that opens the Scheda paziente is still labelled 'Passaporto sanitario', although the tab has been renamed to Crescita / 'Passaporto e FSE'. This may confuse users.

action_items: Fix the signer_mismatch false positive: strip the relation prefix ('Mamma:', 'Papà:', ...) from guardian before comparing, both in the backend and in KindForm. Prefill the signer with the name without the prefix.
On FSE consent revoke, stop the queued sends (in_coda -> non_inviato with reason), or check the consent in fse.advance.
On un-obscure, don't requeue reports already accepted/sent. Keep their previous FSE state.
Keep the 'Passaporto e FSE' tab selected after the patient edit is saved.
Give the absent consent badges a visible background or border in the header.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2064 lines; FSE endpoints could move to a router module next to fse.py.
The passport consents list returns the full signature (base64, up to 400KB each) for every consent, which makes the payload heavy.
The mismatch check is implemented twice with different normalisation (frontend toLowerCase vs backend _fold). Use the backend flag only, or share the logic.

success_rate.backend: 100% of tests pass (10/10); 2 logic defects found by inspection and reproduction

seed_data_creation: None kept. Pietro Fontana (6ad86e64c06e50ff4cd67d4d) patient doc and its 2 consultations were backed up to /tmp/bk_*.json and restored with mongoimport --mode=upsert. Test consents I created were revoked and then deleted by id. /fse/pending is back to count 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n 0: pytest tests/test_fse_passport.py -n 0. It mutates Pietro Fontana (signs the draft 6ad894264b41e81ff20f7eac, sets CF), so back up first: mongoexport -d mantmed -c patients -q '{"_id":{"$oid":"6ad86e64c06e50ff4cd67d4d"}}' and consultations with patient_id. Restore with mongoimport --mode=upsert, then delete the created consents by id. Scheda paziente is reached via Pazienti -> click patient -> button 'Passaporto sanitario'. Login: landing-login-btn -> login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button.
rca of the issue: signer_mismatch: demo guardians are stored as '<Relazione>: <Nome Cognome>' and the comparison uses the full string. Reproduce: register an FSE consent for Pietro Fontana with signer 'Ilaria Fontana' -> consent-mismatch shown. Revoke leak: fse.advance() doesn't check patient.fse_consent_at, and revoke_consent -> refresh_patient_consent never touches the consultations.
